# Command reference

The command line has two separate catalogs. A `:` command runs a named navigation or state action. A `/` composer command runs a palette action, including destructive and selection actions that `:` deliberately does not expose.

Both parsers leave an unknown name visible: `:` reports `Unknown command: <text>` and `/` keeps the draft and flashes the composer border for one second.

## `:` command line

The catalog contains 17 commands. A command without an argument column ignores extra words.

| Command | Arguments | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `:settings` | none | Open agent Settings for the active or selected agent. |
| `:limits` | none | Open the dispatch-limits panel. It edits group hops, command hops, depth, and continuations. Saved values apply to new commands only; running groups keep their captured caps. |
| `:approvals` | none | Open the full-height approval inbox. |
| `:workspace` | none | Open the workspace picker and switch the active workspace. |
| `:agent` | none | Open the agent picker and start a direct chat. |
| `:new-agent` | none | Open the new-agent wizard. |
| `:new-workspace` | none | Open the new-workspace wizard. |
| `:edit-workspace` | none | Edit the active workspace's members and leader. |
| `:pause` | none | Pause the active workspace. A paused workspace rejects new work. |
| `:resume` | none | Resume the active workspace. |
| `:init` | none | Start a System Agent init job for the active workspace. Init is solo-only: `:init` takes no mentions, skills, or extra text. It writes the generated `AGENTS.md` block and `.ensemble/init.json`. `/init` and `Space i` reach the same path; `:ensemble-init` is not a valid command. |
| `:native` | none | Open the active agent's native session. |
| `:native-first` | on\|off\|shadow | Set the native-first migration mode through the validated settings path. `off` and `shadow` keep the legacy tool surface. `on` does not clear an explicit `toolSurface: legacy`; use `:tools native` to restore the native tools. |
| `:tools` | native\|legacy | Set the tool surface through the validated settings path. `:tools native` restores the native list after a legacy override. `nativeFirst: off` or `shadow` still forces the legacy list. |
| `:logs` | [failures \| task <id>] | Open the read-only log viewer. No argument shows recent entries; `failures` filters the failure sink; `task <id>` filters one work item. Invalid arguments show `usage: :logs [failures \| task <id>]` |
| `:help` | none | Open the generated keyboard help overlay. `?` opens the same help. |
| `:q` | none | Leave Ensemble deliberately and return the keys to the native OpenCode host. It does not quit OpenCode; `Esc` never quits. |

Start a System Agent init job for the active workspace. Init is solo-only: `:init` takes no mentions, skills, or extra text. It writes the generated `AGENTS.md` block and `.ensemble/init.json`. `/init` and `Space i` reach the same path; `:ensemble-init` is not a valid command.

**Catalog description:** initialize workspace files

**Arguments:** none (extra words are ignored)

### `:native`

**Catalog description:** open the native session

**Arguments:** none (extra words are ignored)

### `:native-first`

Set the native-first migration mode through the validated settings path. `off` and `shadow` keep the legacy tool surface. `on` does not clear an explicit `toolSurface: legacy`; use `:tools native` to restore the native tools.

**Catalog description:** set native-first on, off, or shadow

**Arguments:** `on|off|shadow`

**Example:** `:native-first on`

### `:tools`

Set the tool surface through the validated settings path. `:tools native` restores the native list after a legacy override. `nativeFirst: off` or `shadow` still forces the legacy list.

**Catalog description:** set the tool surface native or legacy

**Arguments:** `native|legacy`

**Example:** `:tools native`

### `:logs`

Open the read-only log viewer. No argument shows recent entries; `failures` filters the failure sink; `task <id>` filters one work item. Invalid arguments show `usage: :logs [failures | task <id>]`

**Catalog description:** show recent logs (failures | task <id>)

**Arguments:** `[failures | task <id>]`

**Example:** `:logs failures`

### `:help`

Open the generated keyboard help overlay. `?` opens the same help.

**Catalog description:** show keyboard help

**Arguments:** none (extra words are ignored)

**Example:** `:help`

### `:q`

Leave Ensemble deliberately and return the keys to the native OpenCode host. It does not quit OpenCode; `Esc` never quits.

**Catalog description:** leave Ensemble

**Arguments:** none (extra words are ignored)

**Example:** `:q`

## `/` composer catalog

The composer catalog contains 15 commands. It is not the same list as `:`; neither parser falls through to the other catalog.

| Command | Catalog description | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `/workspace` | switch workspace | Open the workspace picker. |
| `/agent` | mention an agent | Insert a `$` agent mention into the composer. This is not the `:agent` picker. |
| `/settings` | agent settings | Open agent Settings. |
| `/limits` | dispatch hop limits | Open the dispatch-limits panel. |
| `/approvals` | approval inbox | Open the full approval inbox. |
| `/pause` | pause workspace | Pause the active workspace. |
| `/resume` | resume workspace | Resume the active workspace. |
| `/init` | initialize workspace files | Start a workspace-only, solo-only init job. Extra words are rejected. `/ensemble-init` is an accepted alias. |
| `/help` | shortcut help | Open keyboard help. |
| `/native` | open native session | Open the active agent's native session. |
| `/delegate` | delegate selected subtask | Delegate the selected Work item. |
| `/retry` | retry selected subtask | Retry the selected Work item. |
| `/restart` | restart selected subtask | Restart the selected Work item. |
| `/cancel` | cancel selected subtask | Cancel the selected Work item. |
| `/reset-ensemble` | delete all Ensemble data | Delete all Ensemble data after typing `RESET`, then confirm whether to delete handoffs too. |

### Composer examples

`/workspace` opens the workspace picker. `/agent` inserts a mention instead of opening a picker. `/init` and `/ensemble-init` run workspace init; `/reset-ensemble` is the destructive reset.

## Semantic differences

- `:` has no destructive command. `/` has `/reset-ensemble`, `/cancel`, and the other selection actions, with their confirmations.
- `/` has no `:native-first`, `:tools`, `:logs`, `:q`, `:new-agent`, `:new-workspace`, or `:edit-workspace`.
- `:` has no `/delegate`, `/retry`, `/restart`, `/cancel`, or `/reset-ensemble`.
- `:init` and `/init` both work. `/ensemble-init` works; `:ensemble-init` does not exist.
- `:native-first on` sets the migration mode but does not clear an explicit legacy tool surface. `:tools native` is the restore.
- `:init` is solo-only. A `:init <mention>` or `/init` with extra words is rejected before any job starts.
